title: Community mappings fallback integrated into node_mappings pipeline
description:
Problem
Common workflow nodes (e.g., SetNode/GetNode) can be missing from registry + manager-derived mappings, forcing repeated per-workflow custom_node_map entries in comfygit core.

Goal
Add a curated community mappings input in this repo and merge it into the daily build output (data/node_mappings.json), so core resolver gets the fallback through existing Priority 3 mapping resolution with no new resolver stage.

Design constraints
- Keep core resolver unchanged for this feature (data-layer solution).
- Community mappings should be applied only as a fallback when registry/manager mappings are absent for that node key.
- Preserve existing ranking behavior for registry/manager data.
- Keep implementation minimal and maintainable for MVP.

Acceptance criteria
- Final built node_mappings.json contains curated fallback entries for configured community nodes (initially SetNode/GetNode -> comfyui-kjnodes).
- Existing registry or manager mappings for a key are never overwritten by community fallback data.
- Pipeline remains deterministic and schema-compliant.
- Tests cover merge precedence and seeded SetNode/GetNode behavior.

title: Add curated community mappings source file and initial seed entries
description:
Create a tracked community mappings input (e.g., config/community_mappings.json or TOML) with clear schema and provenance fields.

Include initial seed entries for:
- SetNode -> comfyui-kjnodes
- GetNode -> comfyui-kjnodes

Include fields needed for maintainability (reason/source_url/added_at or equivalent) and short contributor guidance in README/docs.

title: Integrate community fallback merge into registry-data build pipeline
description:
Implement a merge step in the existing pipeline (likely update_registry/augment_mappings path) that injects community entries into final mappings only when a node key is unresolved after registry + manager augmentation.

Rules:
- Do not replace existing mapping rows.
- Preserve ranking semantics for rows that already exist.
- Ensure referenced package IDs resolve in packages table (or fail loudly with validation message).
- Keep output schema compatibility with current comfygit core loader.

title: Add tests for community fallback precedence and seeded Set/Get behavior
description:
Add integration/unit tests in comfygit-registry-data covering:
- Fallback insertion when key is missing.
- No insertion/overwrite when key already exists from registry or manager.
- Initial SetNode/GetNode entries appear with expected package mapping in built output.

Keep tests focused and fast (happy-path + key precedence edge case).

title: Document operational workflow for community mappings maintenance
description:
Document how to propose/edit community mappings, validation expectations, and how daily pipeline picks them up.

Include note that this mechanism is a fallback layer for known blind spots (e.g., frontend-only/metadata-missing nodes), not a replacement for registry or manager-derived mappings.

title: Global Node Override Mappings
description: Add a curated node_overrides.json file for mapping nodes that can't be auto-resolved by the registry pipeline. Primary use case: frontend-only JavaScript nodes (like SetNode/GetNode from KJNodes) that are invisible to the backend-scraping pipeline. The overrides file is consumed by comfygit-core's GlobalNodeResolver as a fallback between properties lookup and the main registry mapping table. Format: { "node_type": { "package_id": "...", "reason": "...", "source_url": "..." } }. Should be versioned alongside node_mappings.json and fetched by the same data manager.
close_reason: Superseded by crd-90m (community mappings merged into node_mappings pipeline)

title: Create node_overrides.json with initial JS-only node mappings
description: Create data/node_overrides.json alongside existing node_mappings.json. Initial entries: SetNode -> comfyui-kjnodes, GetNode -> comfyui-kjnodes. Schema: { "version": "...", "overrides": { "NodeType": { "package_id": "...", "reason": "js-only-virtual-node", "source_url": "https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes" } } }. Include metadata for each override (reason, source URL, date added). Update README with format docs and contribution guidelines.

title: Include node_overrides.json in GitHub release artifacts
description: Update the GitHub Actions publish workflow to include node_overrides.json as a release artifact alongside node_mappings.json. Ensure the data manager in comfygit-core can fetch it from the same release URL pattern.
